contracts: Dictionary-side starts accept 0..=D; D is the frame-zero boundary, including an empty dictionary without an owner.

D+H+B and H+B indexed extents are checked; frame_position stays u64 and its history subtraction/current-input addition are checked separately. Overflow is ResourceLimit.
Methods borrow immutable views and fixed stack scratch only. They do not allocate, clone, change owners, mutate ring contents or retain pointers.
